description: Inject shared LEARNINGS context and the preflight advisory.

hooks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH:-/usr/bin:/bin}"; adapter="$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/codex-learnings-hook.py"; if [ -n "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && [ -x "$adapter" ]; then exec "$adapter"; fi; exec "${LEARNINGS_CORE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share/learnings-md-system}/adapters/codex/codex-learnings-hook.py"

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH:-/usr/bin:/bin}"; [ ! -f "${LEARNINGS_CORE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share/learnings-md-system}/hooks/preflight-gate.py" ] || UV_CACHE_DIR="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/learnings-md-system/uv-cache" uv run --no-project --offline --python '>=3.11' python "${LEARNINGS_CORE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share/learnings-md-system}/hooks/preflight-gate.py" || true; cat >/dev/null
